title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
cScaleSummary: C2 because boneless skinless chicken breast is the only meaningful cholesterol-contributing ingredient, and the portion is held to about 4 ounces raw chicken per serving. The rice, vegetables, herbs, spices, vinegar, lemon juice, tahini, olive oil, and seasonings contribute little to no cholesterol.
ldlActiveSummary: Not LDL-Active because the recipe is centered on animal protein. It remains an EWHF-friendly lower-cholesterol main because it uses lean chicken, vegetables, herbs, spices, tahini, acid, and controlled unsaturated oil instead of butter, cream, animal fat, or heavy cheese.
intro: Shawarma belongs to the family of spit-roasted, spice-driven street foods found across the Eastern Mediterranean and the Middle East. A home rice bowl keeps the same appeal: warm spices, browned edges, sharp pickles, crisp vegetables, herbs, and a creamy garlic sauce. The pleasure comes from contrast, not heaviness.

items.prep: rinsed until the water runs mostly clear

stepGroups.title: Cook the Rice
items: Add the rinsed basmati rice ({{quantity:basmati-rice}}), water ({{quantity:water}}), and kosher salt ({{quantity:salt-rice}}) to a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes.
Turn off the heat and let the rice sit, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

stepGroups.title: Marinate the Chicken
items: In a bowl, combine the chicken breast ({{quantity:chicken}}), olive oil ({{quantity:olive-oil}}), lemon juice ({{quantity:lemon-juice-chicken}}), garlic ({{quantity:garlic}}), ground cumin ({{quantity:cumin}}), ground coriander ({{quantity:coriander}}), paprika ({{quantity:paprika}}), ground turmeric ({{quantity:turmeric}}), ground cinnamon ({{quantity:cinnamon}}), black pepper ({{quantity:black-pepper}}), and kosher salt ({{quantity:salt-chicken}}). Toss until evenly coated.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 20 minutes at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 8 hours.

stepGroups.title: Make the Garlic Tahini Sauce
items: In a bowl, whisk together the tahini ({{quantity:tahini}}), lemon juice ({{quantity:lemon-juice-sauce}}), cold water ({{quantity:water-sauce}}), grated garlic ({{quantity:garlic-sauce}}), and kosher salt ({{quantity:salt-sauce}}).
The sauce will tighten at first, then loosen into a creamy consistency as the liquid is incorporated.

stepGroups.title: Cook the Chicken
items: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken in a single layer and cook for 4 to 5 minutes without moving it too much so the spices and marinade develop browned edges.
Flip and continue cooking for another 3 to 5 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and lightly charred in spots.

stepGroups.title: Build the Bowls
items: Divide the basmati rice between bowls. Top with the cooked chicken, diced cucumber ({{quantity:cucumber}}), diced tomatoes ({{quantity:tomatoes}}), sliced red onion ({{quantity:red-onion}}), and chopped parsley ({{quantity:parsley}}).
Spoon the garlic tahini sauce over the bowls and serve immediately.
